arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}Imbue your weapons with festering shadows for {c_number}{buffduration:SHADOW_CHARGES}{/c} seconds. While imbued, your {c_important}Imbueable{/c} Skills deal Shadow damage and infect enemies for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds. Infected enemies explode on death, dealing {c_number}{payload:DEATH_AOE}{/c} damage to all surrounding enemies. 

If the infection expires before the enemy dies, it will deal {c_number}{payload:EXPIRATION_FIZZLE}{/c} damage to only that enemy.

{c_label}Passive:{/c} {c_important}Shadow Imbuement's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_31}|1|]{/c} seconds each time you kill an enemy.

Any enemies you infect with {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} take {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_DAMAGE}{/c} damage every second until the infection ceases.

Evading through an enemy infected by {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} seconds and explodes the infection for {c_number}[{SF_34} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Shadow Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} chance to create a {c_important}Shade{/c} that explodes after {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} second, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_EXPLOSION}{/c} damage. This can only happen once every {c_number}[SF_40|2|]{/c} seconds, affected by Attack Speed.
{c_important}Shadow Imbued{/c} Skills and {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds.
When {c_important}Shadow Imbuement's{/c} infection expires, {c_important}Shadow Imbuement's{/c} duration is increased by {c_number}[{SF_37}|1|]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}{SF_38}{/c} seconds.
When {c_important}Shadow Imbuement's{/c} infection expires, you have a {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} chance to gain {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.
You have {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance against enemies infected by {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c}.
